!Command: show running-config
!Shaped after Cisco's NX-OS 9.3 VXLAN guide (Configure Tenant Routed Multicast); the
!overlay-distributed-dr, advertise evpn multicast, s-g-hash and mcast-routing override
!lines were typed on cisco-25gb, the rest follow the guide.

version 9.3(16) Bios:version 07.71
feature ngmvpn
feature nv overlay
advertise evpn multicast
ip multicast overlay-distributed-dr
ip pim evpn-border-leaf
vrf context red
  vni 50001
  ip multicast multipath s-g-hash next-hop-based
  address-family ipv4 unicast
    route-target both auto mvpn
    route-target import 65001:50001 mvpn
vrf context blue
  vni 50002
interface nve1
  host-reachability protocol bgp
  mcast-routing override source-interface loopback10
  member vni 50001 associate-vrf
    mcast-group 239.3.3.3
  member vni 50002 associate-vrf
router bgp 65001
  address-family ipv4 mvpn
    retain route-target all
  address-family l2vpn evpn
    advertise-pip
    maximum-paths 4
  neighbor 192.0.2.1
    remote-as 65001
    address-family ipv4 mvpn
      send-community extended
